item.tib: dge spyod 'phags nor bdun gyi nang tshan skyabs 'gro'i rnam bshad nyung 'thus
item.coloph: zhes pa'i tshul 'di ni/ spyir kho bo rang bzhin shes rab zhan pa'i khar gzugs gzhi bde min la brten nas/ brtsam bya 'bri bar mi 'os shing / mkhas rnams khrel ba'i rgya las ma 'das kyang / snga sor byi ba lo nang du/ mdo smad kyi zhing nas mtshan dang don mtshungs smon rgyal mchog sprul rin po che rnam gnyis nas bka' rten sna tshogs sems la gang shar re gnang na bstan 'gror phan nges snang bas/ dam tshig la ma ltas par brtsam pa gnang dgos zhes/ rten 'brel gyis (gyi) gnang rten dang bcas pa'i gsung shog phab pa dang lhag par snya chen rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam rol rtsa ba'i bla ma sum ldan grub dbang rin po che nas/ rin chen dang po zho gang dang*/ lha rdzas dri med bcas brtsal te/ dkon bzhi skyabs 'gro'i tshigs 'grel zhig brtsam dgos zhes/ bka' lung spyi bor phab pa gyen zhu ma nus pa dang / deng chabs cig mdo smad sde dge lcang lung sprul sku nas phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang dang sbyar ba'i zhabs brtan smon tshig rten 'brel bla na med du gyur bzhin sgo rigs skam zhig kyis (gi) rus thob/ khyi la seng ge'i ming btags su/ rgyal ba mnyam med chen po'i gdan sa 'dzin khul sman ri'i mkhan ming nyi ri shel zhin zur wer du 'bod pas/ 'dus gnas g.yas ru mkhar sna'i ri khrod/ bde gsal gsang phug ces par/ sgo gsum bskyed rgyar skyong khul gyis (gyi) thun mtshams su sbyar ba/ ri khrod du yig cha du mas dben pa dang / nad bab kyis brjed nges che zhing / dran pa mi gsal bar brten/ zung (zur) 'grel tsam las ma gyur bar dbyings khrel mi bzhes pa dang / dge bas sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa srid mthar brtan zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig tha tshan mu tsug smar ro//
